verdict.rationale: Workable's pricing page lists a first-party "Custom report builder", so the product ships its own reporting capability. Nothing documents which funnel metrics it covers or whether they break down per role and team. The stages, events, and offer API endpoints are developer building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented stage-conversion reporting, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness reporting, offer-accept rate reporting, per-role/per-team breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I see the hiring funnel honestly — stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-accept rates per role and team
